checks.detail: Canonical example, Draft 2020-12 schema, and JSON-LD context parse as JSON.

The canonical example validates against every Draft 2020-12 keyword used by the state schema, including references, composition, object closure, required fields, constants, enums, patterns, formats, ordered prefix items, item closure, uniqueness, and cardinality.
Storyboard frames are ordered F0, F1, F2, and F3.
Capability, human-workflow, and gate identifiers are unique across the canonical model.
The prototype's embedded MODEL value is structurally identical to the packaged canonical JSON.
The primary HTML contains no external script or stylesheet reference; its interface, styles, model, and behavior are inline.
Both static SVG derivatives parse as XML.
Both static SVGs include title and description elements; the interactive SVG uses an aria-labelledby title/description pair.
The standalone prototype includes a prefers-reduced-motion treatment.
Headless Chrome exercised F0–F3 at 1440, 736, 390, and 320 CSS pixels with no console errors, page errors, or remote runtime requests.
Document scroll width matched client width at 1440, 736, 390, and 320 CSS pixels.

limitations: This receipt does not replace assistive-technology testing in representative browser and screen-reader combinations.
Cross-file referential integrity is checked procedurally because JSON Schema cannot express every registry reference constraint.
Pixel-level visual regression screenshots and representative screen-reader sessions are outside this package-level validation receipt.
